line.name: Saint Luis Rey Tabacales
line.description: Billed as 'the first regular-production Dominican Saint Luis Rey' - the first time in the brand's history a premium SLR has been made in the Dominican Republic, rather than Honduras. A tribute to the tobacco harvest ritual in the Dominican Republic's Cibao Valley. Blend created by Rafael Nodal and the Grupo de Maestros team; described as reduced-strength versus the traditional Honduran-made SLR. Released first week of August 2025, previewed at the 2025 Altadis Traveling Road Show. IMPORTANT: unlike every other line in this batch, Tabacales does NOT share the brand's default Honduran origin/factory - confirmed consistently across 3 independent sources.
line.factory: Tabacalera de Garcia, La Romana, Dominican Republic
line.origin_country_override: Dominican Republic (overrides the brand's default Honduran origin for this line only)
